subject: Request to extend demo window while finance approves PO
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.inference.com>
To: Samuel Pierce <sam.pierce@crescentlabs.com>, Crescent Labs Procurement <procurement@crescentlabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Fri, 04 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request to extend demo window while finance approves PO

Hi Sam —

Thanks again for the productive demo yesterday. I know your team is lining up final approvals with Finance and Procurement, and you mentioned the PO routing could take several business days. To keep your evaluation momentum (and the integration tests your engineers started) from stalling, can we provision a short extension — 7 business days — of the sandbox credits and the existing seat access?

What I propose:
- We extend the trial sandbox by 7 business days starting today.
- Provide a small provisional token top-up so your engineers can finish the end-to-end test cases (we can cap it to match the current run-rate).
- This is temporary; once the PO arrives we'll reconcile and convert the usage to the contracted seat.

If Procurement needs a written approval note or an internal accounting code, I can get Marissa to issue a short authorization email. Attached is a one-page summary of what the provisional top-up would include.

Would that work for you? If yes, I’ll loop in Marissa and confirm the exact token amount.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
(Attachment: trial_usage_report.pdf (pdf))

From: Samuel Pierce <sam.pierce@crescentlabs.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Crescent Labs Procurement <procurement@crescentlabs.com>
Date: Fri, 04 Jun 2027 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request to extend demo window while finance approves PO

Kim —

Appreciate the offer. Our procurement queue is a bit backed up due to end-of-quarter approvals; CFO signed off on the need but AP is gating the PO until Monday at the earliest. A 7-business-day extension with a capped token allowance sounds reasonable. Could you confirm the cap in concrete numbers? Procurement also asked for a written note that the extension is temporary and that usage will be reconciled when the PO is issued.

I’m adding Procurement here so they have visibility. I’ll confirm internal timelines on Monday and can accept an authorization email if that helps speed things up.

Thanks,
Sam
Head of Platform Engineering
Crescent Labs

On Fri, Jun 4, 2027 at 09:12 AM Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.inference.com> wrote:

> 
> Thanks again for the productive demo yesterday...

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
To: Samuel Pierce <sam.pierce@crescentlabs.com>, Crescent Labs Procurement <procurement@crescentlabs.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.inference.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Fri, 04 Jun 2027 10:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request to extend demo window while finance approves PO

Hi Sam and Procurement team —

Quick note from Sales Ops: we can provision a temporary extension and add a capped token allotment of 150k tokens (equivalent to roughly three additional days at your current usage pattern) immediately. This will keep the sandbox endpoints and all existing seats active.

Terms of the provisional credit:
- Duration: 7 business days from 06/04/2027.
- Cap: 150,000 tokens (usage beyond this will be throttled; we’ll notify you if you approach the limit).
- Reconciliation: once the PO is received and the contract is activated, we will convert the used tokens to the contracted billing or issue a credit if applicable.
- This extension is explicitly temporary and does not change any pricing or contractual commitments.

If Procurement needs an internal reference, please use: Redwood provisional extension — Deal CRES-2026-048.

Attachment: Crescent_PO_summary.xlsx (simple PO placeholder)

Kimberly, David — consider this our approval to proceed. Sam, please confirm you’re comfortable with the cap and duration and I’ll push the extension live.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Samuel Pierce <sam.pierce@crescentlabs.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Crescent Labs Procurement <procurement@crescentlabs.com>
Date: Sat, 05 Jun 2027 15:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request to extend demo window while finance approves PO

Marissa — thanks, that works for us. We accept the 7-business-day extension and the 150k token cap. Procurement, we’ll note the internal reference Marissa provided and route the PO with that tag.

Appreciate the quick turn — this keeps our engineers in the loop and avoids rework.

I’ll circle back once AP has the PO in hand.

Best,
Sam
Head of Platform Engineering
Crescent Labs
